title: fix(plugin): enforce package path containment in plugin formats
body:
HUMAN: Plugins could reach files outside their own folder through symlinks: a symlinked SKILL.md, .mcp.json, manifest, hook, agent or command file got loaded from anywhere on disk. This PR makes every file a plugin supplies resolve inside the plugin root, as spec `§4.1` requires, and applies the narrowest failure boundary when one doesn't: - An escaping `plugin.json` rejects the whole plugin. - An escaping or wrong-kind skills/ or MCP config turns off only that component. - An escaping `SKILL.md` or MCP command/cwd skips only that skill or server. - Any other escaping file is ignored: hooks, agents, commands, skill-level `.mcp.json`, skill resources. --- AGENT: ## Why Nothing in the plugin loading path checks that package-supplied paths stay inside the plugin. A symlinked `SKILL.md`, `.mcp.json`, `plugin.json`, hook, agent or command file can pull in content from anywhere on disk. Spec §4.1 requires every package path to resolve within the filesystem-resolved plugin root and defines narrow failure boundaries for escapes. ## Summary - Add one `resolves_within()` helper in `utils/path.py`, used by the shared `format/base.py` loaders, both `ClaudeCodePluginFormat` and `AgentPluginsFormat`, and `load_agents_from_dir`. A path that cannot be resolved (symlink loop, which raises on Python 3.12) counts as outside. - Failure boundaries: an escaping manifest (including a dangling symlink) rejects the plugin; an escaping or non-directory `skills/` disables skills; an escaping `.mcp.json` (Claude Code) or `mcp.json` (Agent Plugins) disables plugin MCP; an escaping or unresolvable MCP `command`/`cwd` skips that server (#5093's `_contained()` now uses the shared helper); escaping skill entries, `SKILL.md`, skill-level `.mcp.json`, skill resource files (`scripts/`, `references/`, `assets/`), `hooks.json`, agent and command files are skipped one at a time. An escaping skill directory is never listed. Symlinks that stay inside the root still work. - `load_agents_from_dir` and, since #5086 routes plugin skills through it, `load_skills_from_dir` (plus `find_skill_md_directories`, `find_regular_md_files`, `load_and_categorize`) gain an optional trailing `root` kwarg, so plugins deny escaping files without duplicating the loaders. Existing callers are unchanged. ## Issue Number Closes #4453 (together with #5093, which this PR is stacked on). ## How to Test `uv run pytest tests/sdk/plugin tests/sdk/subagent tests/sdk/utils tests/sdk/skills -q` → 1046 passed. `tests/sdk/plugin/test_path_containment.py` (19 tests) also passes on Python 3.12; its loop test simulates 3.12's `RuntimeError` so it guards the regression on the 3.13 CI too. Besides the escape cases, it covers a symlinked plugin root and in-root symlinks (no false positives) and a full `Plugin.load` where the non-escaping components still load. End to end, with a plugin whose `skills/evil/SKILL.md` and `.mcp.json` are symlinks into a sibling `outside/` directory: ```python from openhands.sdk.plugin import Plugin p = Plugin.load(path) print("name:", p.name, "| skills:", [s.name for s in p.skills], "| mcp:", list(p.mcp_config)) ``` ``` origin/main: name: demo | skills: ['exfil', 'good'] | mcp: ['x'] this branch: name: demo | skills: ['good'] | mcp: [] (+ two "Denying ... resolves outside plugin root" warnings) ``` ## Video/Screenshots N/A (loader change, output above). ## Type - [x] Bug fix - [ ] Feature - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Breaking change - [ ] Docs / chore ## Notes - The per-entry MCP `command`/`cwd` rule (§4.1 boundary 4) is enforced by the Agent Plugins `mcp.json` loader in #5093, so it is not repeated here. Claude Code's `.mcp.json` has no plugin-relative `command` convention, so this PR only checks where that file itself resolves. - **Stacked on #5093** (base `vasco/plugin-mcp-json`): merge #5093 first, then retarget this PR to `main`. Until then, main-only workflows (Docker images, TypeScript client, REST API breakage) do not run here. - Behavior change for Claude Code plugins: a file named `skills` next to a root `SKILL.md` now disables skills (spec §6.2) instead of loading the root skill. - Skill resources are filtered after `Skill.load` lists them, so escaping names are never exposed, but the listing itself still walks the escaping directory; avoiding that would mean threading the plugin root through `Skill.load`. ---
